measurement_scope.runs: One instrumented request per endpoint at each size; one shared synthetic database, expanded in place.
measurement_scope.cold_definition: Fresh Dashboard request, SQLite connection, Snapshot and QueryReads caches. Not OS cold-cache; imports and Store.connect setup are outside the observed SQL/VM range.
measurement_scope.sql_scope: Application SQL after Store.connection yields and before it resumes cleanup. Includes BEGIN, excludes connection setup/teardown. No write connections during requests.
measurement_scope.vm: SQLite progress handler interval 100; callback_count*100 is an estimate. Nominal unfinished batches can be up to 99 instructions per statement. SQLite may invoke progress during preparation; category attribution around statement boundaries is approximate, not an exact per-query instruction count.
measurement_scope.memory: tracemalloc measures peak Python allocations during instrumented request, including response, loader caches and instrumentation; excludes SQLite native memory, OS cache and preconstructed raw-outcome observation set. Connection setup peak is recorded, then reset_peak separates application body peak; overall peak is their maximum. EXPLAIN is collected outside all measured metrics.
measurement_scope.json: Global Python json.loads calls during request. Exact raw strings of unrelated complete calculation.outcome are counted separately. SQL JSON extraction is not a Python decode and is reflected in VM estimates.
measurement_scope.cache_counts: Distinct IDs across every QueryReads instance created by the request, including typed fact versions and full calculation payloads.
measurement_scope.interpretation: Historical funding records are unrelated to selected-month employee/asset payloads, but each is a real 100-fen cash/capital effect. Historical cash/ledger aggregation legitimately processes more rows; total VM is not required to stay constant. Jobs and audit additions reference only historical funding sources.
measurement_scope.bounds: This concentrated sample measures observed growth, not all possible workloads; relevant obligations, complete hit manifests, requested provenance and exact source graphs retain their real input/output costs. Existing semantic/EXPLAIN evidence remains separate.

index.name: dependency_scope_any_kind
index.purpose: Bound source=calculation plus exact @subject/#calculation dependency declarations without a kind predicate. Wrong-kind declarations remain candidate sources whose issues are resolved by shared business semantics.
index.actual_lookup_sql: WITH RECURSIVE related(id) AS (SELECT c.id FROM json_each('["exact-source"]') ids JOIN calculation c ON c.subject_id=ids.value UNION SELECT d.calculation_id FROM dependency_calculation d JOIN related r ON r.id=d.upstream_id UNION SELECT d.calculation_id FROM related r JOIN calculation c ON c.id=r.id JOIN dependency_scope d ON d.source='calculation' AND d.scope_key IN ('@'||c.subject_id,'#'||c.id)) SELECT DISTINCT c.subject_id FROM related r CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=r.id
query_plan: SEARCH c USING COVERING INDEX calculation_subject (subject_id=?)
SEARCH d USING COVERING INDEX dependency_upstream (upstream_id=?)
SEARCH d USING COVERING INDEX dependency_scope_any_kind (source=? AND scope_key=?)

cost_results: Four real Dashboard endpoints with 48 unrelated funding records across 23 past months: zero unrelated complete outcome decodes, metadata hydration or typed facts; query-stage2 records instrumentation.
Bank statement 3 vs 503 normalized rows: zero full parent facts; 41 funding records with filtered page size 2 hydrate exactly 2 facts; summary hydrates none.
60 display profiles: employee-key enumeration hydrates none; five employee keys hydrate exactly five profiles and zero assets. Twelve tax identity facts hydrate only two exact employee facts.
Related old state proof excludes later manifests where the old calculation only repeats as a dependency; complete relevant adoption graph remains intact.
Context tests prohibit full report construction; Reports excludes unrelated earlier-year direct account outcomes while retaining exact necessary historical sources and gross classifiers.
Worker mutation without business epoch change rejects file cursors; a worker write during one response is not visible until the next transaction.

Centralized same-book cost profile records SQL statement count, approximate SQLite VM work, JSON decodes, request cache size and Python tracemalloc peak before and after unrelated historical source/job/audit growth. Actual figures and source hashes are retained in the cost-profile stage; no wall-clock or constant-VM guarantee is inferred.
limits: SQL cash opening and investment cost aggregates still grow with relevant historical effects; no constant-cost promise for full financial output.

Accurate whole-domain totals still require scalar data for the corresponding domain. Related settlement summaries must inspect real related obligations and relations. One large immutable batch and the complete selected adoption proof cannot be truncated.

Exact-hit index verification cannot discover an arbitrarily deleted reverse-index source that is no longer hit. Explicit full integrity verification compares all original supported references and detects omissions.

Synthetic integration and render tests are not a claim of real-data scale benchmarking or a manual browser UX review. No production company DB, live service startup, deployment or business write occurred.
